booking_strategy.winter_outing_2027: NYC Tourism Winter Outing 2027 (Hotel Week 25% off, Restaurant/Broadway/Must-See 2-for-1) runs 2 Jan - 11 Feb 2027 and ends 4 days BEFORE 15 Feb 2027.
booking_strategy.flight_booking_window: Expedia 2026 Air Hacks reports US domestic sweet spot 31-45 days out; Google Flights reports ~39 days US domestic (range 22-57d) and 50-133d international (~129d avg) — Feb 15 AMS-JFK sits squarely in the early-booking window now (~81 days out).
booking_strategy.hotel_booking_window: Lock a $0-prepayment free-cancellation Black Friday hotel rate now (Fairfield cancel free until 2027-02-12) and re-check weekly / mid-Jan 2027 in case shoulder promos drop further.
